role: Implementation Consultant, Canadian Health Information Systems
headline: Implementation Consultant | Clinical Software Configuration, Validation and Adoption | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US EHR company, implementing, configuring and training clinicians on healthcare software across close to 200 client practices. I run discovery on clinical workflows, configure to fit, validate before go-live and drive adoption afterwards, so I know what makes a clinical system stick with the people who use it.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices: discovery on workflow pain points, practice-specific configuration, testing and go-live support.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on new workflows and features.
Collected feedback from clients, grouped recurring pain points into PRDs and feature requests, and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: discovery, workflow documentation, configuration, validation and testing, go-live support, adoption
end-user training for providers, nurses and medical assistants, documentation, client check-ins
AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), React, GitHub, n8n; emergency, ICU and ambulatory clinical workflows
thesis_html: Clinical software only works when clinicians use it. I implement it that way.
